Third-party libraries, kept with the site so it does not depend on another host.

  gsap.min.js            GSAP 3.15.0                GreenSock Standard "No Charge" licence
  ScrollTrigger.min.js   GSAP ScrollTrigger 3.15.0
  SplitText.min.js       GSAP SplitText 3.15.0
  CustomEase.min.js      GSAP CustomEase 3.15.0
  lenis.min.js           Lenis 1.3.26               MIT licence

Each file keeps its own licence header. To update one, replace it with the same file from the
library's npm package (its dist/ folder).
